scientific.integrity: All lattice identities and the bounded enumeration are exact over the integers; literature comparison is limited to the inspected source, targeted database searches, and closely related indexed records.
scientific.limitations: Finite primitive-ample census only through square 16 on the explicit rank-two Picard lattice; no assertion about the full polarization spectrum or projective model of the square-16 class.

title: Low-degree polarization spectrum of the explicit discriminant-17 K3 surface
